title: The Slag Vicar's Cut
story: On the rim road above a grumbling volcano, Ghelmarrow the Slag Vicar guards the only bridge and demands a "cut" of every hoard that crosses. Mr 6 is escorting 480 ember coins rescued from a collapsed mine, meant to be split evenly among the eight ash-villages below. Ghelmarrow smirks, certain that nobody ever checks his arithmetic.
question: If Ghelmarrow takes 35% of the 480 ember coins and the rest is shared equally among the 8 ash-villages, how many ember coins does each village receive?
solution: Shared out: 312 ÷ 8 = 39 ember coins for each village.
praise: Finding 35% of 480 was the right first move — the last step was splitting what was LEFT (480 - 168) among the eight villages.
hint: Work in order: first find the vicar's 35%, then see how many coins are still in the chest, and only then divide.
victory: Mr 6 counted the shares out loud, and Ghelmarrow — who had been quietly overcharging by rounding wrong for eleven years — turned the color of cooled slag and fled into a lava tube. The ash-villages now post a tally board at the bridge, written in very large numbers.
imagePrompt: A stooped stone-and-cinder vicar monster in scorched robes weighing coins on the lip of a glowing volcano bridge while a numeral-six knight tips out a chest of ember coins, orange firelight and drifting ash.
